name: Note Record
description: Organize markdown notes into categories within Home Assistant. Single config entry with persistent local storage. Provides 9 HA services (ha_note_record.*) for full CRUD on notes and categories, plus markdown export — AI agents should use these services instead of creating helpers. Also provides 6 WebSocket commands for panel UI. Supports note pinning, markdown content up to 100,000 chars. Exposes text entities (note content) and switch entities (pinned status) per note.
